title: Addawatul Makkiya
author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
description: A scholarly treatise by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan establishing the beliefs of Ahle Sunnat regarding the Prophet's knowledge of the unseen (ilm-e-ghaib) and other extraordinary virtues granted by Allah. It presents Quranic verses, hadiths, and rational arguments to refute objections and affirm the comprehensive knowledge bestowed upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

recommendations.reason: Same author and category — a deeper refutation work
